patch_description: Full rewrite with three improvements. (1) Bottleneck-directed proposals: most moves push a vertex of the currently smallest triangle perpendicular away from its opposite edge, directly raising the bottleneck area; occasional random Gaussian moves maintain exploration. (2) Simulated annealing with adaptive step size and temperature decay, plus a final deterministic greedy polish sweeping small axis-aligned steps on bottleneck vertices until convergence. (3) Robust multi-start over diverse geometric seeds with fixed RNG seeds; the whole constructor is wrapped in a try/except falling back to the regular 13-gon so no trivial bug can zero the score (no gradient/rescale chain-rule code, no dead lines). Score is affine-invariant, so no rescaling is needed during moves. Time budget ~8s, all triangle areas vectorized over the 286 triples.
